author: Cobratate
text:
If you or a family member has experienced illegal punishment while detained at FDC Miami, contact my lawyer Joseph McBride immediately.

I understand throughout the thousands of violations committed by this prison, the majority have been against people who are yet to be convicted of any crime - like myself.

The actions of this facility will be brought to light.
